C30 · Abstract algebra assignment planner

610 exercises · 140 supplied hints · 76 empty response slots

This planner selects exercise references; it does not copy exercises into a new worksheet. Local numbers follow source exercise groups, not PDF page numbers. Across both courses there are 213 populated hints; 116 empty response slots are not supplied answers or solutions. 99 exercises are in the Sage edition only. Frozen references follow edition 2026.08.22.2. Current online reader links have been checked, but their content may differ from the frozen archives. Both interfaces point to Indonesian books.

Book archives and offline reading
